title: Zesty Turnip Gratin
description: A creamy, flavorful side dish that's perfect for any occasion. The zesty twist adds a nice kick to the classic gratin.
instructions: Peel and thinly slice the turnip.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced turnip, garlic, and thyme. Add enough water to cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the turnip is slightly tender.
In a separate saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the zesty cheese and grated cheese, stirring until melted and smooth.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the cooked turnip to a baking dish and top with the cheese sauce.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
